title: Portaless Starter — Implementation Guide
description: A clean Portaless starter site with a practical 3-step setup guide, one reference page, and one sample Markdown post.

props.title: Your Portaless site is ready
props.subtitle: This clean starter profile is your starting point after cloning or forking Portaless. Follow the three steps below to replace this guide with your own site.

props.text: Three steps to launch your site

props.items:
server :: 1. Edit your home page :: Open site-profiles/starter/home.json to change the title, theme, and Visual Elements blocks shown on the root route.
package :: 2. Add posts and pages :: Write Markdown posts under site-profiles/starter/posts/ and JSON pages under site-profiles/starter/pages/ using starter-guide.json as a template.
shield :: 3. Configure and deploy :: Set PORTALESS_SITE_URL (or PORTALESS_PUBLIC_URL on self-host), complete /setup if self-hosting, enable MCP or Trust Layer when ready, and publish.

props.text: Deploy the compiled HTML to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for a zero-runtime static site edited in Git. When you want the visual editor, /setup onboarding, MCP agent editing, approved-snapshot publishing, or the Trust Layer, run the Node or Docker self-hosted runtime.
